title: Design System: Sales School Landing Page

display.purpose: Hero statement words and first-glance identity.

body.purpose: Support labels and contextual narrative text.

label.purpose: Uppercase utility metadata and navigation markers.

motion.name: hero-ease
motion.purpose: Primary reveal easing for staged hero elements.

motion.name: hero-duration
motion.purpose: Standard timing for line-item entrance transitions.

components.name: Primary Navigation Link
components.description: High-tracking uppercase footer navigation link with sparse red hover response.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4em; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 300; text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ef4444; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 4px; color: #ef4444; }

components.name: Signal Status Dot
components.description: Compact presence indicator paired with timeline metadata.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #dc2626; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220,38,38,0.5); }

components.name: Hero Wordmark
components.description: Two-line hero lockup with heavy display and thin counterpart line.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { text-align: right; } .ds-wordmark-main { margin: 0; color: #ffffff; font-family: "Space Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 15vw, 12rem); line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-wordmark-sub { margin: -0.12em 0 0; color: #ffffff; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 15vw, 12rem); line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: 0.16em; font-weight: 300; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Synthesized canonical CTA aligned to the existing monochrome-plus-red language.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 20px; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #ef4444; border-color: #ef4444; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Synthesized text field for future form modules, preserving the current visual language.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #ffffff; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #ef4444; }

narrative.overview:
This system stages a single cinematic moment, a high-contrast portrait where typography carries authority and pacing does the persuasion. The aesthetic is intentionally sparse, but not passive. Visual weight is concentrated in oversized wordmarks, disciplined uppercase micro-labels, and one load-bearing accent that signals intent.

The experience is built for recruiter-speed scanning and leadership signaling, not feature marketing. Content appears in a calm sequence, then resolves into a clear directional statement. The overall voice is confident, strategic, and operations-minded, with no decorative detours.

The system explicitly rejects the anti-references in PRODUCT.md: generic SaaS product styling, corporate-template feature blocks, and conversion-led marketing patterns that bury personal narrative.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic monochrome field with sparse red signaling
Display-led hierarchy with compressed vertical rhythm
Uppercase metadata language for tactical clarity
Motion used for reveal and emphasis, never flourish

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Red remains rare and intentional. If red becomes background fill or broad decorative wash, hierarchy collapses.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Hero line-height stays compressed at 0.8 so language feels cut from one block, not stacked as separate banners.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain visually flat at rest. Depth cues appear through overlays and controlled contrast, not container elevation.

dos: Do keep red as a sparse directional signal (#ef4444 / #dc2626), not a broad surface fill.
Do preserve the recruiter-speed hierarchy with oversized hero language and tracked micro-labels.
Do maintain strong narrative ordering: identity first, context second, directional statement last.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences when extending animations beyond current reveal choreography.
donts: Don't design this like a generic SaaS product or app landing page.
Don't use feature-marketing patterns that feel corporate-template heavy.
Don't replace personal storytelling with product-style conversion blocks.
Don't introduce side-stripe accents, gradient text, or interchangeable icon-card grids that dilute the current voice.
